differences.what: massing: the long north flank, the round tower close behind the front, the two very tall stacks and the front block's steep street hip stand where the plate draws them, the stacks' tops and the tower's top within about 10-25 px through this view's camera (fitted to them, the hip's apex and the front's north eave)
the street hip's pitch: the plate's front hip rises to its finial at about 15.9 m, 6.4 m over the 9.5 m eave; built at 52 degrees (T-3280), where T-3279 had 45

the round tower's top: the plate carries the tower past its third tier of windows as a plain band to a flat top with a heavy edge; built as a fourth, windowless 1.9 m storey under K08's nearly flat tin cap (T-3280), where T-3279 had a slated cone and finial
the broad street dormer of three lights under its gable: built 3.3 m wide with three lights (T-3280)

where the broad dormer stands along the front: through this camera its face lies about 1.6 m south of the front's centre, where the 2004 photograph shows it about 1 m north of it; built on the centre, between the two readings
the smaller one-light street dormer near the front's south end and the stack rising behind the broad dormer at the front block's south side: not built (K01 carries one street dormer)
the broad dormer's stone-coped gable with kneelers and finial: built with the kit's plain slated verges

the rear ranges' roofs: the plate draws a broad gable over the rear range, steep gables stepping down the flank and a row of small gabled dormers with pinnacles between them; built as two plain slated gables (T-3279)
the north flank's two-storey bays with flat tops across the middle and rear ranges, and their stone mullioned windows: not built, the ranges' north walls are flat with single sashes
stone belts and dressings: the plate shows pale stone string courses, quoins and window dressings across the brick; built with stone lintels and a single sill course
the front's lower storeys, its bow and the stoop: the parkway trees hide them
the electric street lamp, the automobile, the parkway trees and the fence's pattern: not part of this record

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
